choice.seafarers.title: Choose your ship
choice.seafarers.intro: Every sailor gets one free ship, and a new one if she sinks. Use her deed on open water to launch her.
choice.seafarers.intro_later: Choose a ship. Use her deed on open water to launch her.
choice.seafarers.intro_swap: Your ship and everything aboard her will be gone. Your crew joins you on the new one.
choice.seafarers.sloop.desc: Small and nimble. One mast, two cannons.
choice.seafarers.brigantine.desc: Two masts, four cannons, a brig. Fastest of all with the wind on her beam.
choice.seafarers.galleon.desc: Three masts, eight cannons, a brig. Fastest downwind, hard to sink.
choice.seafarers.join_crew_hint: Sail aboard a friend's ship. You can still choose a ship of your own later with /crew choose.
choice.seafarers.wait: You can get a new ship in %s.
choice.seafarers.confirm_swap: She'll be gone, with everything still aboard her. Empty her stores first!
item.seafarers.sloop_deed.tip: Use on open water to launch a Sloop
item.seafarers.deed.warning: Warning: she's very large! Use only in open water, well away from land and other ships.
item.seafarers.deed.swap: Your crew will join you aboard.
item.seafarers.ships_compass.tip: Points to your crew's ship, wherever she's sailed. Hold it to see how far she is.
message.seafarers.seas_full: The seas are full: this server allows %s ships. Try again when one has sunk or been given up.
hint.seafarers.helm: %1$s / %2$s turn the wheel; she stays where you leave her. %3$s to step away.
hint.seafarers.sail_rope: Hold %1$s to let the sail down, %2$s to haul it up. %3$s lets go of the rope.
hint.seafarers.brace_rope: Hold %1$s / %2$s to swing the sail round; angle it to catch the wind. %3$s lets go.
hint.seafarers.capstan: %1$s drops the anchor. Hold %1$s to heave it up; let go too soon and it unwinds.
hint.seafarers.cannon: Load with ammo in hand, %1$s to man her, aim with the mouse, %2$s to fire. %3$s to step away.
hint.seafarers.harpoon: Aim with the mouse, %1$s to fire, hold %2$s to reel in. %3$s to step away.
hint.seafarers.oars: %1$s / %2$s to row, %3$s / %4$s to turn. %5$s to stand up.
hint.seafarers.stove: Put raw food on. Take it off when the smoke turns white, or it burns.
hint.seafarers.water_barrel: Fill a bucket or a bottle. It refills itself in time.
hint.seafarers.grog_barrel: Fill a glass bottle or a bucket with grog. Each drink makes you drunker...
hint.seafarers.map_table: Her arrow moves on the chart as she sails. %1$s + %2$s opens the chart to mark it.
hint.seafarers.quest_table: The ship's ledger: voyages, crew and the ship. Captains invite, lock and swap from here.
hint.seafarers.bunk: Sleep here and you'll respawn aboard her, wherever she sails.
hint.seafarers.flag_box: Use with a banner to hoist it at the masthead.
hint.seafarers.bell: The bell calls your crew: they'll hear who's ringing.
hint.seafarers.rowboat_hook: Use beside a rowboat to tie her on; she's towed wherever the ship goes.
hint.seafarers.bucket_rack: Fill the bucket from the water in the hold, then throw it over the side with %1$s.
hint.seafarers.hull_hole: Patch it: %1$s on the hole with planks in hand.
message.seafarers.crashed: She's run aground! Holes in the hull: patch them!
death.attack.seafarers.cannonball: %1$s was blasted overboard by a cannonball
info.seafarers.deed: A deed launches a ship. It can't be crafted or found: every player gets one when they choose their ship the first time they join (or with /crew choose). Use it on open water, well away from land.
info.seafarers.compass: Points to your crew's ship wherever she's sailed; hold it to see how far she is. Your first deed comes with one.
info.seafarers.rowboat: Rowboats can't be crafted or found in chests: they wait, tied up, along the world's coasts. Anyone can row one. This item is for Creative and testing.
info.seafarers.cannonball: Load a cannon with it and fire: cannonballs knock holes in hulls. A ship's supply barrels start with plenty.
info.seafarers.chain_shot: Tears sails and breaks masts, but bounces off hulls.
info.seafarers.firebomb: Fired from a cannon, it sets the ship it hits alight. Put fires out with thrown water.
info.seafarers.cursed: Cursed cannonballs put a curse on the ship they hit and anyone they splash: dropping her anchor, furling her sails, weighing her down, or making her crew drunk, slow, poisoned, tired or dance.
info.seafarers.bucket: Fill it from the water in a flooding hold, then throw it over the side. Thrown water also puts out fires.
info.seafarers.grog: From a ship's grog barrel. Each drink makes you drunker; too many and you'll be sick.
info.seafarers.banana: A ship's food, stocked in her supply barrels.
info.seafarers.ship_part: Part of a ship. Ships are launched whole from a deed; you can also build with these blocks.
message.seafarers.admin_click_tp: Click to fill in /crew admin tp
message.seafarers.admin_unloaded: ...and %s more ships with captains that aren't loaded right now.
message.seafarers.admin_no_ship: No loaded ship matches '%s'. See /crew admin ships.
message.seafarers.claimed_land: This is someone else's claimed land: you can't launch a ship here.
message.seafarers.deed_unused: You already have an unused ship deed. Launch her first (lost it? /crew reclaim).
message.seafarers.already_captain: You already captain a ship, and you can only have one. Swap her at her quest table instead.
message.seafarers.ship_wait: You can get a new ship in %s.
message.seafarers.chose_crew: You'll sail with a crew. Ask a captain to invite you: they pick you at their ship's quest table. Want a ship of your own later? Use /crew choose.
message.seafarers.swap_off: Ship swapping is turned off on this server.
message.seafarers.not_captain: You aren't the captain of a ship.
message.seafarers.swap_far: Your ship must be nearby to swap her.
message.seafarers.swapped_crew: %s swapped the %s for a new ship. You'll join her when she's launched.
message.seafarers.reclaim_off: Replacing lost deeds is turned off on this server.
message.seafarers.reclaim_none: You have no unused deed to replace.
message.seafarers.deed_in_inventory: Your deed is in your inventory.
message.seafarers.deed_in_ender_chest: Your deed is in your ender chest.
message.seafarers.reclaimed: Here's a new deed. Your lost one won't work any more.
message.seafarers.deed_given: You got a %s! Take it to open water, well away from land, and use it to launch her.
message.seafarers.deed_missing: You still have an unused ship deed, but it isn't with you.
message.seafarers.deed_missing_hover: Gives you a new deed. The old one will stop working, wherever it is.
message.seafarers.deed_void: This deed was replaced and no longer works.
message.seafarers.deed_rescued: Your ship deed fell out of the world. It's back in your inventory.
message.seafarers.new_ship_launched: %s launched your crew's new ship. You'll respawn aboard her.
message.seafarers.lost_for_good: Your ship is lost for good.
message.seafarers.lost_for_good_captain: Your ship is lost for good. Choose a new one with /crew choose.
message.seafarers.only_captain_invites: Only the captain can invite players.
message.seafarers.invited: %s invited you to join the crew of the %s.
message.seafarers.not_in_crew: That player isn't in your crew.
message.seafarers.kicked: You were removed from the crew of the %s.
message.seafarers.locking_off: Locking ships is turned off on this server.
message.seafarers.locked_done: Your ship is locked: only her crew can use her.
message.seafarers.unlocked_done: Your ship is unlocked: anyone can use her.
message.seafarers.ship_locked: The %s is locked. Only her crew can use her.
voyage.seafarers.nobody_near: Nobody else is near the table.
voyage.seafarers.captain_hint: Click a name, then choose what to do. ★ marks the captain.
voyage.seafarers.crew_hint: Click a nearby player, then Invite.
voyage.seafarers.lock_hint: Locked: only her crew can steer, sail, fire, use her storage and bunks, or break blocks on her. Anyone can still walk aboard.
voyage.seafarers.swap_hint: Trade her for a new ship. She and everything aboard her will be gone; your crew comes with you.

info.seafarers.brig: The brig's door, below decks on the Brigantine and the Galleon. When most of a crew votes for it (/crew brig <player>, or the crew page of the voyage table), that crewmate is locked in the brig. They can't work the ship from there, but can still bail. After a few minutes the crew can vote them out again (/crew release <player>).
